goal: Proceed with completing the theory of everything
this_stage_status: Public baseline reanalysis and conditional moving/composite spectrum calculations completed; no new-field fit or exclusion
achieved_this_stage: Reanalyzed 95 experimental fringe scans comprising 3895 count observations from Zenodo 17502163, with independent linear least-squares fit checks.

Recomputed ordinary quantum and classical visibility using the original grating kernel; retained the published contrast factor explicitly; documented why this is not an exact published-figure replication.
Identified a deposited-code/paper optical cross-section mismatch and quantified its effect without choosing either branch as the complete correct calibration.
Derived and numerically checked the spacelike dynamic thermal spectrum for the quadratic scalar operator and its unequal-mass ordered conversion extension.
Derived the moving rigid-composite rate, discrete scalar charge structure factor and conditional Talbot-Lau harmonic attenuation mapping.
Documented finite-time memory limitations and the contrast/attenuation degeneracy; no scalar or Theory-of-Everything validation inferred.

numerical_results.note: These are deterministic calculation checks and input-sensitivity differences, not experimental significance or confidence intervals.

Reconcile additional public supplementary photophysics, transmission and velocity calibration information if available. Do not contact authors without user authorization.
Use independent datasets to discriminate a predicted dependence; examine the public atom data duplicate-like final rows before using them as independent observations.

full_goal_open_requirements: A common internally consistent quantum and gravitational framework covering the claimed scope.
Recovery of established particle physics and gravity in controlled limits and empirical constraints on its parameters.
A physically justified scalar state, occupation or abundance rather than an unmeasured freely chosen bath.
Apparatus calibration, complete finite-path response and statistically identifiable comparison with real observations.
Distinctive quantitative predictions, independent experimental validation and substantive expert scrutiny.
scope_restrictions: No claim that a Theory of Everything has been solved.
No scalar fit, detection, exclusion, bath temperature, mass or abundance measured.
No substitution of the deposited collapse-model parameters for Higgs-portal parameters.
Internal AI cross-checks are not external peer review.
No user source documents or downloaded author files edited.
